Endlessly demanding of attention, and savagely violent when ignored, producing nothing but waste.

I can relate to this sentence describing SCP-173 more than anything that implies 173's sentience.

item.content:encoded:
A good take on ol' Stumpy. And I like the character of the creator, having written an anartist with similar views.

As if art requires meaning. Manipulating reality to imply one thing or other, to send some message or make some kind of statement.

Where once again, irony or self-awareness or something strikes because 173 exists purely to showcase the artist's dim view of humanity.

item.content:encoded:
So this is the first tale I've written, done specifically for the 173 anniversary celebration.
The concept is obvious enough, so I just ran with it - guy who created the statue decides to pay it a visit on the anniversary of its creation. Obviously he would be anomalous himself, and being an anomalous artist type I figured he would have a pretty dim view of both the Foundation and other artists.

Anyway, thanks to everyone who looked this over.
